context.guidance: For a Third Schedule class, send the Data Principal a notice at least 48 hours before erasure under Rule 8(2), telling them the erasure is due and how to stop it. Build the notice into the erasure job so that it always runs ahead of deletion and cannot be skipped. Apply the requirement only where the Third Schedule class condition is met, not by default.

value.fix: Do not add the 48-hour notice to the route handler. Add it to the erasure job, gated on the Third Schedule class condition. When the job picks up a deletion request for a Data Principal whose fiduciary class meets that condition, it should (1) record a scheduled erasure date at least 48 hours out, (2) send the Data Principal a notice under Rule 8(2) stating the erasure date and how to stop it (for example, by logging in or submitting a retention request), and (3) perform the deletion only after the notice has been sent and 48 hours have passed, with the check enforced in code so it cannot be skipped. Store the notice timestamp and the cancellation path on the PrivacyRequestModel record. For Data Principals outside the Third Schedule class, keep the existing immediate erasure behavior. Before shipping, add tests covering: notice sent before deletion, deletion blocked before the 48-hour window ends, cancellation honored, and no notice path for non-Third-Schedule classes.
